item.description:
• The setup screens have their fireflies back: they drift and light up under your pointer again while you set your kit up, and the sky of your memories takes over when your kit starts reading.
  • When you import VS Code history during setup, VS Code is now switched on as a connected tool, the way every other tool already was.
  • The update screen's title is easier to read over your memories.
  • The waking screen links to the walkthrough film again.
